questions.stem: 社區裡的樂齡大學，是我祖父這兩年來一直在學畫畫的地方。
questions.answer: The senior university in our community is the place where my grandfather has been learning to paint for two years.
accepted_answers: The senior university in our neighborhood is the place where my grandfather has been learning to draw for the past two years.
The community senior university is the place where my grandfather has been taking painting classes for two years.

patterns: 現在完成進行式（這兩年來一直在…）

questions.stem: 對那些熱愛學習的退休人士來說，這些課程已經帶來許多樂趣。
questions.answer: For those retired people who love learning, these courses have brought them a lot of joy.
accepted_answers: For those retired people who enjoy learning, these classes have already brought a lot of fun.
These courses have already brought a lot of joy to those retired people who love learning.

patterns: 對於…的人而言（for those who …）

1.explanation_zh: 主詞「社區裡的樂齡大學」譯成 The senior university in our community（地點片語放在名詞後）。「…的地方」要改成名詞＋關係副詞子句：the place where …，子句中「在那裡」的意思由 where 表達，所以不能用 which。「這兩年來一直在學畫畫」從過去持續到現在而且還在進行，用現在完成進行式 has been learning to paint for two years（for 接一段時間）。
evidence: 我祖父這兩年來一直在學畫畫的地方
1.strategy_zh: 看到「…來一直在…」想到 have/has been＋V-ing；看到「…的地方／…的時候／…的原因」想到 where／when／why 子句。
hints: 切成四段：社區裡的樂齡大學／（是我祖父）這兩年來／一直在學畫畫／的地方
標的詞彙：community（社區）、senior（年長的）、university（大學）、grandfather（祖父）、paint（畫畫）、place（地方）
句型框架：S + is the place where + S + has been + V-ing + for …

2.explanation_zh: 「對那些…的人來說」用 For those (people) who …：For those retired people who love learning；關係子句的動詞要和複數先行詞一致（love，不加 s）。「已經帶來許多樂趣」用現在完成式 have brought them a lot of joy／fun；joy、fun 都是不可數名詞，用 a lot of 或 much。
evidence: 對那些熱愛學習的退休人士來說
2.strategy_zh: 中文「對…的人來說」常可譯成 For those who …；先確認 those 指的是誰，再讓關係子句的動詞跟著單複數變化。
hints: 切成四段：（對那些）熱愛學習的／退休人士（來說）／這些課程／已經帶來許多樂趣
標的詞彙：retire（退休）、love（熱愛）、learn（學習）、course（課程）、bring（帶來）、joy（樂趣）
句型框架：For those + N + who + V …, S + have + p.p. …

references: The senior university in our community is the place where my grandfather has been learning to paint for two years.
The senior university in our neighborhood is the place where my grandfather has been learning to draw for the past two years.
The community senior university is the place where my grandfather has been taking painting classes for two years.

patterns.label_zh: 現在完成進行式（這兩年來一直在…）

accepted: The senior university in our community
The senior university in our neighborhood
The senior university in the community
The university for seniors in our community

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「樂齡」不要逐字翻，指的是給年長者上課的大學，說 senior university 或 university for seniors。
接一段時間用 for；since 後面接時間的起點（since 2024）。
「這兩年來一直在學」是從過去持續到現在而且還在進行，要用現在完成進行式 has been＋V-ing。
完成進行式是 have/has been＋V-ing。

common_errors.wrong: is the place which my grandfather has been learning to paint
common_errors.right: is the place where my grandfather has been learning to paint
common_errors.explanation_zh: 子句裡已經有完整的主詞和動詞，缺的是「在那裡」，要用關係副詞 where（＝in which），不能用 which。

traps.literal_error: my grandfather is learning to paint for two years
traps.explanation_zh: 「…來一直在…」要用現在完成進行式 has been learning，配 for two years。

traps.zh: 我祖父這兩年來一直在學畫畫的地方
traps.literal_error: is my grandfather has been learning to paint place
traps.explanation_zh: 「…的地方」修飾語很長，英文要寫成 the place where＋子句。

1.restructuring_zh: 「是我祖父這兩年來一直在學畫畫的地方」是很長的前置修飾，英文要先寫 the place，再用關係副詞 where 引導子句 where my grandfather has been learning to paint for two years。

references: For those retired people who love learning, these courses have brought them a lot of joy.
For those retired people who enjoy learning, these classes have already brought a lot of fun.
These courses have already brought a lot of joy to those retired people who love learning.

patterns.label_zh: 對於…的人而言（for those who …）
patterns.frame: For those (+ N) who + V …, S + V

common_errors.explanation_zh: 先行詞 those retired people 是複數，關係子句動詞不加 s。

common_errors.right: those retired people who love learning
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「熱愛學習的」要改成關係子句放在名詞後面。
「退休的」用形容詞 retired 修飾 people。

accepted: have brought them a lot of joy
have already brought a lot of fun
have already brought a lot of joy
have given them a lot of fun

common_errors.right: have brought them a lot of fun
common_errors.explanation_zh: fun、joy 是不可數名詞，用 a lot of／much，不加 s。

common_errors.wrong: have bring them a lot of joy
common_errors.right: have brought them a lot of joy
common_errors.explanation_zh: 現在完成式用過去分詞 brought。

traps.literal_error: For those love learning retired people, …
traps.explanation_zh: 「熱愛學習的退休人士」要改成 those retired people who love learning，用關係子句後位修飾。
fun、joy 不可數，「許多」用 a lot of／much。

bonus.text: What these courses have brought those retired people who love learning is a great deal of joy.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用 What … is … 的準分裂句強調「帶來的是樂趣」，屬於加分寫法；一般的現在完成式句子就能拿滿分。

2.restructuring_zh: 「對那些熱愛學習的退休人士來說」要改寫成 For those retired people who love learning，前置修飾改成 who 引導的關係子句。

1.translation: The university for seniors in our community is the place where my grandfather has been learning to paint for the past two years.
1.explanation_zh: 「……是……的地方」用 the place where 關係副詞子句；「這兩年來一直在學」用現在完成進行式 has been learning … for the past two years；「樂齡大學」沒有固定英文，譯為 the university for seniors（也可 senior citizens' college）。信心 medium 主要因為「樂齡大學」的譯名不固定，題目也沒附英文。

2.translation: For those retired people who love learning, these courses have already brought them a lot of joy.
2.explanation_zh: 「對……來說」用 For …；「熱愛學習的退休人士」用限定關係子句 retired people who love learning；「已經帶來許多樂趣」用現在完成式 have already brought … a lot of joy（joy、pleasure、fun 皆可）。

issues_zh: （小建議，不影響判定）「樂齡大學」是台灣特有的名稱，沒有固定英文，題目也沒有在括號附英文；P1 的 accepted 與 senior／university 的 alternatives 已放得夠寬（elderly、older、college 都算），但學生可能寫成 learning center for seniors 之類，建議批改時從寬或在 accepted 再補。
R1 these classes have already brought a lot of fun 少了受詞對象（brought … fun 不接 to them 讀起來不完整），且 bring fun 不是最自然的搭配；建議改成 have already brought them a lot of pleasure／joy。
P4 可接受寫法 have given them a lot of fun 不是道地英文（give sb fun 不自然），建議改成 have given them a lot of pleasure；common_errors 的訂正 have brought them a lot of fun 也建議改用 joy 或 pleasure。

problems: 第 2 題驗證者對參考譯文有意見（warn）：R1 these classes have already brought a lot of fun 少了受詞對象（brought … fun 不接 to them 讀起來不完整），且 bring fun 不是最自然的搭配；建議改成 hav

1.translation: The senior university in the community is the place where my grandfather has been learning to paint for the past two years.
1.explanation_zh: 中文是「A 是 B 一直在學畫畫的地方」，用 the place where 關係副詞子句；「這兩年來一直在學」用現在完成進行式 has been learning ... for the past two years；「樂齡大學」譯為 senior university。

2.translation: For retirees who love learning, these courses have already brought a great deal of joy.
2.explanation_zh: 「對那些…來說」用 For retirees who love learning；「已經帶來」用現在完成式 have already brought；「許多樂趣」用 a great deal of joy（joy 不可數）。

issues_zh: 部分切分有漏洞：「是我祖父」沒有放進任何一個部分，而標的詞彙 grandfather 卻被掛在第 3 部分「一直在學畫畫」底下，該部分的 accepted 全都沒有 my grandfather，學生把祖父譯錯（例如 grandmother）也不會被扣分。建議把「我祖父」併入第 3 部分，accepted 改成 my grandfather has been learning to paint 這類寫法，「是」併入第 4 部分。
備註：參考譯文的 senior university 是直譯，英文讀者可能把 senior 想成「四年級」；university for seniors 較清楚（第 1 部分 accepted 已收）。

status_reason: 判定者人工審查（第 1 輪）：評分規準有實質問題。①第 1 題 4 部分切分不一致：「是我祖父」沒有放進任何一個部分，標的詞彙 grandfather 卻掛在第 3 部分「一直在學畫畫」底下，該部分的 accepted 全都沒有 my grandfather（祖父漏譯或譯錯都不會被扣分）；hints 的切分又把「（是我祖父）」放在第 2 部分「這兩年來」，學生看到的鷹架和評分規準對不上（驗證者 B 判 warn）。②第 2 題第 4 部分 accepted 收了 have given them a lot of fun，give sb fun 是常見的中式英文，不該列為可接受寫法；參考譯文 R1 these classes have already brought a lot of fun 沒有受惠對象，bring fun 的搭配也不自然（驗證者 A 判 warn）。另：「樂齡大學」是台灣特有名稱，題目沒有在括號附英文（README §3.5）。重生時把「我祖父」併入第 3 部分（my grandfather has been learning to paint）、「是」併入第 4 部分並同步修改 hints；第 2 題改用 joy／pleasure（have brought them a lot of joy、have given them a lot of pleasure），刪掉 give … fun 與不接對象的 brought a lot of fun；「樂齡大學」在括號附英文或改寫題目。
